summary.text: Mitch Ostlie is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 12 (home city listed as Jamestown), serving since 2020 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Ostlie lists an occupation of Insurance Sales.
It lists education as BS, Education, Mayville State.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Ostlie's standing committee assignments as Industry, Business and Labor (vice chair) and Political Subdivisions.
